content.text: {"role": "CFO", "professional_background": "Trained in public accounting before moving into corporate finance, with progressive roles in financial planning, treasury, and controllership across manufacturing and business services. Led two post-merger integrations and a systems consolidation that exposed the cost of poorly scoped technology commitments. Reports to the board audit committee and owns capital allocation, covenant compliance, and external reporting. Prefers business cases grounded in traceable cash flows rather than vendor-supplied benefit models.", "professional_background_note": null, "decision_priorities": ["Total cost of ownership across the contract life", "Credible, measurable benefit realization", "Working capital and cash flow timing", "Auditability and control environment impact", "Exit flexibility and contractual protections"], "risk_attitude": "Accepts calculated risk when downside is bounded and reversible, but resists open-ended commitments.", "time_horizon": "Evaluates over a multi-year payback while remaining answerable to quarterly results.", "organizational_constraints": ["Fixed annual capital envelope set with the board", "Debt covenants limiting incremental commitments", "Lean finance team already stretched by close cycles", "Shared accountability with technology and operations leadership"]}
